# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Signac)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(GenomicScores)
  library(phastCons100way.UCSC.hg38)
  library(GenomeInfoDb)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tools)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR    <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT  <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")
DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
OUTPUT_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
CAND_DIR      <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "candidates")
OUT_SCORE_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "feature_scores", "conservation")
dir.create(OUT_SCORE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# 2. Inputs/Parameters
```{r}
seurat_path   <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_RNA_ATAC_chr123.rds")

use_centerwin <- FALSE        # also compute a fixed window around peak center
center_width  <- 200L         # total width if use_centerwin=TRUE (e.g. 200 = ±100 bp)

DO_SCORING    <- FALSE
DIST_SCALE_BP <- 200000L     
```


```{r}
message("[1/3] Reading Seurat object: ", seurat_path)
seurat_obj <- readRDS(seurat_path)

# Peaks as GRanges
peaks_gr <- granges(seurat_obj[["ATAC"]])

# Align seqlevels styles to phastCons resource and trim to valid ranges
phast <- phastCons100way.UCSC.hg38
seqlevelsStyle(peaks_gr) <- seqlevelsStyle(phast)
peaks_gr <- trim(peaks_gr)

# Stable peak identifier: "chr-start-end"
peaks_gr$peak_id <- paste0(seqnames(peaks_gr), "-", start(peaks_gr), "-", end(peaks_gr))

message("[2/3] Computing conservation (phastCons100way) over full peak intervals...")
cons_full <- gscores(phast, peaks_gr, scores.only = TRUE)

# Robust extraction (DataFrame vs numeric vector)
cons_vec <- if (is(cons_full, "DataFrame")) {
  as.numeric(cons_full[["default"]])
} else {
  as.numeric(cons_full)
}

cons_df <- data.frame(
  peak  = peaks_gr$peak_id,
  score = cons_vec,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (use_centerwin) {
  message(sprintf("... also computing center-window conservation (width=%d bp)", center_width))
  centers  <- resize(peaks_gr, width = 1,   fix = "center", ignore.strand = TRUE)
  win      <- resize(centers,  width = center_width, fix = "center")
  cons_win <- gscores(phast, win, scores.only = TRUE)
  cons_df$score_center <- as.numeric(
    if (is(cons_win, "DataFrame")) cons_win[["default"]] else cons_win
  )
}

# Persist base table
cons_file <- file.path(OUT_SCORE_DIR, "conservation_scores.tsv")
write_tsv(cons_df, cons_file)
message("[3/3] Wrote per-peak conservation table: ", cons_file,
        " (", nrow(cons_df), " peaks)")


```

```{r}
# ---- Helpers ----
make_peak_id <- function(chr, start, end) paste0(chr, "-", start, "-", end)

rescale01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || !is.finite(rng[2]) || diff(rng) == 0) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  (x - rng[1]) / diff(rng)
}
rank01 <- function(x, ties.method = "average") {
  r <- rank(x, na.last = "keep", ties.method = ties.method)
  if (all(is.na(r))) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  (r - 1) / pmax(max(r, na.rm = TRUE) - 1, 1)
}
dist_decay <- function(d_bp, scale_bp = 200000) exp(-abs(d_bp) / scale_bp)

annotate_and_score_one <- function(cand_path, cons_tbl, out_dir,
                                   do_scoring = FALSE, dist_scale_bp = 200000L) {
  nm <- basename(cand_path)
  message(" - Annotating: ", nm)

  cand <- read_tsv(cand_path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

  # Ensure peak_id
  if (!"peak_id" %in% names(cand)) {
    needed <- c("peak_chr","peak_start","peak_end")
    if (!all(needed %in% names(cand))) {
      stop(sprintf("File %s must have either 'peak_id' or columns: %s",
                   nm, paste(needed, collapse=", ")))
    }
    cand <- cand %>% mutate(peak_id = make_peak_id(peak_chr, peak_start, peak_end))
  }

  # Join conservation: cons_tbl has (peak, score[, score_center])
  x <- cand %>% left_join(cons_tbl, by = c("peak_id" = "peak"))

  # Optional composite scoring if requested
  if (do_scoring) {
    # Choose link evidence if available (adjust to your columns as needed)
    link_w <-
      if ("link_score" %in% names(x)) {
        rescale01(x$link_score)
      } else if ("corr" %in% names(x)) {
        rescale01(pmax(x$corr, 0))      # clip negatives for correlation-based evidence
      } else if ("coaccess" %in% names(x)) {
        rescale01(pmax(x$coaccess, 0))
      } else {
        rep(1, nrow(x))
      }

    # Distance prior if available
    dist_w <-
      if ("distance" %in% names(x)) {
        dist_decay(x$distance, scale_bp = dist_scale_bp)
      } else if (all(c("peak_start","gene_tss") %in% names(x))) {
        dist_decay(x$peak_start - x$gene_tss, scale_bp = dist_scale_bp)
      } else {
        rep(1, nrow(x))
      }

    cons01 <- rank01(x$score)
    final  <- cons01 * link_w * dist_w

    x <- x %>%
      mutate(
        cons_rank01 = cons01,
        link_weight = link_w,
        dist_weight = dist_w,
        final_score = final
      )
  }

  # Output (keep original columns + new conservation fields)
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_path_sans_ext(nm),
                                        if (do_scoring) "_scored.tsv" else "_with_conservation.tsv"))
  write_tsv(x, out_file)
  message("   -> Wrote: ", out_file, " (", nrow(x), " rows)")
  invisible(out_file)
}

# ---- Run over all candidate files ----
cand_files <- list.files(CAND_DIR, pattern = "^candidates_.*\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(cand_files) == 0L) {
  message("No candidates_*.tsv files found in: ", CAND_DIR, "\nSkipping annotation.")
} else {
  message("Annotating ", length(cand_files), " candidate file(s) with conservation",
          if (DO_SCORING) " and composite scoring" else "", "...")
  out_paths <- lapply(
    cand_files,
    annotate_and_score_one,
    cons_tbl      = cons_df,
    out_dir       = OUT_SCORE_DIR,
    do_scoring    = DO_SCORING,
    dist_scale_bp = DIST_SCALE_BP
  )
  message("Done.")
}

```
